what: Slogan letters are stood one by one on a curved path (each letter rotates to the slope at its spot), enter from 200 beyond the path end and stop 180 before the path start — 5s power3.inOut, played once after fonts load when 25% of the panel is visible. For a hero where a company slogan curves in over a U-shaped wave bottom.

options.stop: Stop position — from path start to first character (path coordinates), default 180. On phones the original is 40
options.from: Start position — how far outside the path end it starts (path coordinates), default 200
options.gap: Letter spacing (path coordinates), default 6 — the original is based on width 1500, so on a narrow path (phone viewBox 400) use 6×400/1500 ≈ 1.6
options.space: Word spacing width (path coordinates), default 20 — on the phone path about 5.3 at the same ratio
options.threshold: How much must be visible to start, default .25
options.--fx-size: Text size (path coordinate units, via css), default 92px
options.[data-fx-part=path]: Path the text sits on — a path drawn left to right (required). Text reads in this direction

use: <svg data-fx="path-letters-slide" viewBox="0 0 1500 182" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-label="BRAND FOR RE:SLOGAN" data-fx-path-letters-slide="stop: 180"><path data-fx-part="path" d="M0 0H240C330 0 400 32 455 88 512 146 622 182 750 182S988 146 1045 88C1100 32 1170 0 1260 0H1500"/></svg>

from.where: index.js slogan (.kv__motion) — original layoutLetters·playCopyMotion values (5s power3.inOut, end outside 200 → 180, phone 40)

note: The original uses hand-tuned SVG glyphs per letter and a per-letter spacing table. The part uses font glyphs with a single gap between them. The plate height must follow the viewBox ratio in proportion to the width so letters are not squashed (even with preserveAspectRatio none, do not set a separate height).
